replies.body:
I do believe that you hack.

Scenario #1: In your logs, after suspicious movements I watched, you always did "/stafflist"
Scenario #2: Whenever I was on following (you tp'd), you'd leave to make sure staff wasn't watching.
Scenario #3: I have video evidence of the occurrence. https://youtu.be/UnbxYxNL_Mw.

I've watched the video: it shows blatant FastPlace (you have many instances of where you would place a ton of blocks at a moment's notice), and it shows Kill Aura clearly, especially since that once someone died, you continued hitting, then went to another player, and once another came, you'd hit them even after you were dead.

This doesn't much help your case either:
